ANATOMY: one head with exactly ONE clearly visible natural eye in the center of the forehead above a solid normal nose; NO eye sockets at the sides; two powerful arms, two hands, five fingers each; fully opaque dark charcoal work robes and thick plain leather apron, mature weathered face. POWER: physical refining of iron for a ritual mirror using the hard rocks of heaven; a violent fan of ordinary white-orange forge sparks and hammer-driven scale fly toward the foreground. NO magical fire powers, NO body glow. [amatsumara-c06]
SCALE & CAMERA: extremely low close camera immediately beneath the rock anvil edge, dynamic three-quarter torso fills 80 percent of square, foreshortened hammer and hands; imposing through tight framing, NOT an invented giant body.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant hot orange forge light from below, deep walnut shadows, sharp rim reflections, flying ash and real smoke; dark night around the forge.
SURFACE: deeply weathered skin, soot, coarse opaque cloth, worn plain leather, hammered iron, splintered stone, thick painterly texture.
SETTING: the heavenly rocky forge in Takamagahara, the Plain of High Heaven; a dark metallic mountain and a narrow cloud horizon far behind, not a modern workshop. [amatsumara-c03, amatsumara-c06]
MOOD: sacred, forceful, awe-inspiring, a commanding patron kami of ironworking, never evil, cute, calm, decorative or a casual human craftsman.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, pseudoinscriptions, logo, border, frame, signature or watermark anywhere; exactly one eye, no extra heads, arms, hands or fingers; no design from any film, game, anime or comic; fully covered body, no nudity, no explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes, modern machinery or electric tools.
